egress.terms: 'Fair-Use Traffic' with no published number on the storage page. The offer threads give '7,5 TB Traffic per month included' on the 2 TB plan and describe 'Unlimited @ 5Gbps shared' on the 1 TB special. Conflicting, so treat as 7.5 TB metered per 2 TB. Extra TB of HDD quoted at '+2€ (20€ Annually) per additional TB' in LET thread 217568. That marginal rate is the number worth having.

chaining: Root KVM virtual server with 2.5 to 5 Gbps uplink. Incremental HDD storage is available at 2 EUR per TB.

At 5 TB: €3.50 base (2 TB) + 3 x €2 marginal = €9.50/mo = $10.67 for 5 TB = $2.13/TB — the €2/TB marginal rate is the lowest of the storage providers compared, if the provider will actually build the config. At 20 TB: €3.50 + 18 x €2 = €39.50/mo = $44.37 = $2.22/TB. Sold out.
